disclaimer: Fees, scores, quotas, visa durations and licensing rules change often. Figures are indicative; confirm on the linked official regulator, exam-body and university sites before you apply or pay.

routes.intro: US bachelor's degrees are 4 years and broad: you take general-education courses first and declare a major (usually by the end of year 2), with an optional minor. Professional fields such as medicine and law are postgraduate: you finish any bachelor's degree first, then apply to medical or law school.

items.name: Associate degree + transfer
items.detail: 2 years at a community college, then transfer to a 4-year university (2+2). Cheapest way into a US degree.

items.name: Bachelor's (BA / BS)
items.detail: 4 years. BS is more technical (CS, engineering, sciences); BA is liberal-arts based. Apply through the Common App with SAT/ACT (many universities are test-optional or test-required again, check each).

items.name: Master's (MS / MBA / MEng)
items.detail: 1–2 years. MS in STEM needs GRE (often optional now); MBA needs GMAT/GRE and usually 2–5 years of work experience.

items.name: Professional doctorates (MD, JD)
items.detail: 4 years (MD) / 3 years (JD) after a bachelor's. Entry through MCAT / LSAT and a very competitive pool for international applicants.

items.name: PhD
items.detail: 5–6 years, usually fully funded with a stipend through research or teaching assistantships.

careers.title: US Medical Route (Pre-Med → MCAT → MD → Residency)
careers.regulator: AAMC / ECFMG / NRMP / state medical boards
careers.summary: There is no direct 'MBBS' entry. You need a bachelor's degree with pre-med courses, the MCAT, then 4 years of MD and residency. Very few US MD schools accept international applicants, so many Indian doctors instead enter residency as International Medical Graduates after an Indian MBBS.

steps.detail: Any major plus biology, general and organic chemistry, physics, biochemistry and English. Build clinical, research and volunteering experience.
Scored 472–528. Needed for MD (AAMC) and DO schools. Take it 12+ months before you plan to matriculate.
Apply to MD schools through AMCAS (DO via AACOMAS). Check that each school accepts international applicants and requires funding proof.
2 years pre-clinical + 2 years clinical rotations. USMLE Step 1 (pass/fail) and Step 2 CK are taken during school.
3–7 years of residency in your specialty, applied through ERAS and matched through NRMP. IMGs also need ECFMG certification.
Step 3 during residency, then a full unrestricted licence from the state medical board. Work visa is usually J-1 or H-1B.

careers.title: US Software Engineering (BS CS → Bootcamp/Internships → OPT/H-1B)
careers.regulator: No licence needed; immigration via USCIS
careers.summary: Software engineering is unlicensed in the US; employers hire on skills, internships and projects. The real gate is work authorisation: F-1 OPT, STEM OPT extension, then H-1B.

steps.detail: Choose a CIP-designated STEM program so you qualify for the STEM OPT extension. ABET-accredited programs are a plus. Alternatively MS CS (1.5–2 yrs).
Most full-time offers come from internships. Use CPT (Curricular Practical Training) with your school's DSO approval.
Useful only to add portfolio projects or interview prep; bootcamps do not replace a degree and are not a path to an F-1 visa by themselves.
Post-completion OPT after graduation; apply to USCIS up to 90 days before and 60 days after completion.
Extension for STEM degrees if the employer is E-Verify enrolled. Gives up to 3 years of work and three H-1B lottery attempts.
H-1B is selected by lottery (wage-weighted selection has been introduced, check USCIS); employer-sponsored green cards for Indian nationals have long backlogs.

careers.title: US Accounting (BS Accounting → CPA Exam → AICPA Licensing)
careers.regulator: AICPA, NASBA and the state Board of Accountancy
careers.summary: Becoming a US CPA needs 150 semester credit hours (more than a 4-year bachelor's), four exam sections, and a state licence. Many states accept foreign-educated candidates after a credential evaluation.

steps.stage: 1. BS Accounting or a related degree
steps.detail: Include required accounting and business credits. A 1-year MS Accounting often supplies the extra credits to reach 150.
Each state sets its own education, experience and residency rules. International candidates often pick states such as Guam, Alaska, Colorado or Texas for flexibility. Verify current rules.
Get your Indian degree evaluated by an approved service (e.g. NASBA International Evaluation Services) for the state board.
Core: AUD, FAR, REG, plus one discipline (BAR, ISC or TCP). Score 0–99, pass at 75. Computer-based and can be taken in India at Prometric centres.
Usually 1–2 years of work experience verified by a CPA, and an AICPA ethics exam in many states.
Big 4 and mid-size firms hire from campuses. Accounting is on the STEM OPT list only for certain program codes, check CIP code.

exams.name: GMAT Focus
exams.format: Quant, Verbal, Data Insights (~2 hr 15 min)

exams.name: LSAT
exams.format: Logical reasoning, reading comprehension, writing sample

finder.name: Massachusetts Institute of Technology
finder.cycle: UG: EA Nov 1, RA Jan 1 · PG: Dec

finder.name: Stanford University
finder.cycle: UG: REA Nov 1, RD Jan 5 · PG: Dec

finder.name: University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign
finder.cycle: UG: EA Nov 1, RD Jan 5 · PG: Dec–Jan

finder.name: Georgia Institute of Technology
finder.cycle: UG: EA1 Oct 15, EA2 Nov 1, RD Jan 4 · PG: Dec–Jan

routes.intro: UK undergraduate degrees are specialised from day one: you apply to one subject, not a general programme. Bachelor's Honours degrees take 3 years (4 in Scotland, or with a placement year in England). Applications go through UCAS with a personal statement; most master's degrees are 1 year.

items.name: Foundation / International Year One
items.detail: 1 year pathway for students whose Class 12 board marks are not enough for direct entry. Guarantees progression to a partner university.

items.name: Bachelor's Honours (BA / BSc / BEng / LLB)
items.detail: 3 years (4 in Scotland, +1 for sandwich year). UCAS: up to 5 choices, 15 January main deadline; Oxford, Cambridge and medicine/dentistry/vet close 15 October.

items.name: Integrated master's (MEng / MSci)
items.detail: 4-year integrated route in engineering and sciences; common for chartership (IMechE, IET).

items.name: Master's (MSc / MA / MBA / LLM)
items.detail: 1 year taught. Apply directly to the university, rolling or deadlined; no UCAS.

items.name: PhD
items.detail: 3–4 years; apply directly with a research proposal and supervisor.

careers.title: UK Medicine (UCAT → MBBS → NHS Foundation Programme)
careers.summary: UK medicine is a 5–6 year undergraduate degree, but international places are tightly capped (about 7.5% of seats) and fees are very high. BMAT was retired after 2023; most schools now use UCAT.

steps.detail: Biology and chemistry are essential. Most schools expect very high grades in Class 12 boards or A-levels (A*AA equivalent).
Book for July–September in the year of application. Cognitive subtests score 300–900 each plus a Situational Judgement band. BMAT is no longer offered.
Up to 4 medicine choices. Universities weigh UCAT, grades and interviews (MMI). Check each school's international policy.
Clinical teaching from the early years; some courses include an intercalated year.
Provisional GMC registration at graduation, then FY1 and FY2 via UKFPO. International graduates are lower priority in allocation.
Apply for core or specialty training. Work route: Skilled Worker visa (Health and Care) after graduation.

careers.title: UK Law (LL.B → SQE Exams → Solicitor / Barrister)
careers.summary: Since 2021 solicitors qualify through the Solicitors Qualifying Examination (SQE), not the old LPC. A law degree is not mandatory: any degree plus SQE works. Indian LLB holders can sit the SQE but UK practice also needs 2 years of qualifying work experience.

steps.stage: 1. LL.B (3 yrs) or any degree + conversion
steps.detail: LLB via UCAS. LNAT is required by several universities (Oxford, UCL, King's, Durham and others).
Two 180-question multiple-choice papers on functioning legal knowledge.
Practical oral and written skills assessments.
Can be done at up to four employers, including law clinics and placements.
SRA admission as a solicitor. Barristers instead follow the BSB route: Bar course, exams and pupillage.

careers.title: UK Finance & Accounting (ACA / ACCA → Big 4)
careers.summary: UK finance trainees often join a Big 4 firm after a degree and study for ACA while working, with exam support. Indian students can also start ACCA from home and combine it with a UK degree.

steps.detail: Accounting degrees may give exemptions from some ACA/ACCA papers.
Apply to Deloitte, PwC, EY, KPMG graduate programmes in the autumn of final year.
Certificate level, professional level and advanced level plus 3 years of practical experience.
13 exams across Applied Knowledge, Applied Skills and Strategic Professional plus 36 months of experience.
Becomes ACA/ACCA qualified; routes into audit, tax, advisory and finance leadership.

exams.name: UCAT
exams.format: Verbal, Decision Making, Quantitative, Situational Judgement

routes.intro: Germany has two main types of higher-education institutions. Universitäten (including the TU9 technical universities) are research-oriented; Hochschulen für Angewandte Wissenschaften (HAW or Fachhochschule) are practice-oriented, with mandatory internships and strong employer links. Most public universities charge no tuition (a semester contribution of about €150–€350 applies), except in Baden-Württemberg for non-EU students (~€1,500/semester).

items.name: Studienkolleg (foundation year)
items.detail: 1 year, needed when Class 12 alone is not accepted for direct entry. Ends with the Feststellungsprüfung (T-Kurs for engineering, M for medicine, W for business). Indian students usually need 1 year of Indian university study or a Studienkolleg.

items.name: Bachelor's (B.Sc / B.Eng / B.A.)
items.detail: 3–4 years; at Universitäten theory-heavy, at HAW applied with internships. Taught in German at most, English tracks exist (TestDaF/DSH for German tracks).

items.name: Master's (M.Sc / M.Eng)
items.detail: 2 years. Many English-taught programmes; apply via uni-assist or directly, often with APS certificate from India.

items.name: Dual studies (duales Studium)
items.detail: Paid apprenticeship combined with a degree at companies such as Bosch, Siemens, SAP; needs good German.

items.name: PhD
items.detail: 3–5 years, often as a salaried position at a university or research institute (Max Planck, Fraunhofer).

careers.title: Free-Tuition Engineering (Studienkolleg → B.Sc/M.Sc → TU9 → EU Blue Card)
careers.regulator: DAAD / university admissions offices / Federal Office for Migration (BAMF)
careers.summary: Germany is a top destination for engineers: public tuition is nearly free, and shortage-occupation engineers qualify for the EU Blue Card. The TU9 group is the leading alliance of technical universities.

steps.detail: Indian applicants need the Akademische Prüfstelle (APS) certificate before the visa and, at most universities, before application.
German tracks: TestDaF/DSH (B2–C1). English tracks: IELTS 6.0–6.5 or TOEFL.
T-Kurs for engineering and natural sciences, with a final assessment exam.

steps.stage: 4. B.Sc / B.Eng (3–4 yrs) then M.Sc (2 yrs)
steps.detail: TU9 members: RWTH Aachen, TU Berlin, TU Braunschweig, TU Darmstadt, TU Dresden, Leibniz Hannover, KIT, TU München, Stuttgart. Apply via uni-assist or the university portal.
After graduation you may stay up to 18 months to find a job related to your degree (§20 AufenthG).
Requires a recognised degree and a job meeting the salary threshold (lower for shortage occupations; thresholds change yearly). Permanent residence possible after 21–27 months with B1 German.

careers.title: German Healthcare (Approbation Exam)
careers.summary: Medicine is not offered in English at public universities and entry is tightly restricted for non-EU applicants. The more common route for Indians is to work as a doctor after an Indian MBBS by obtaining the Approbation (licence).

steps.detail: The state authority checks your MBBS for equivalence. If it is not equivalent you must pass a Kenntnisprüfung (knowledge exam).
B2 general German, then the Fachsprachprüfung (medical language exam) at C1 level, required by the Ärztekammer.
Oral-practical exam covering internal medicine, surgery, emergency medicine and pharmacology.
Full licence to practise; apply to the competent state authority. Berufserlaubnis (temporary permit) can allow supervised work meanwhile.
Hospitals regularly hire; doctors qualify for an EU Blue Card.

exams.name: TestDaF / DSH
exams.score: TDN 4 in each part is the usual target

finder.name: Technical University of Munich (TUM)
finder.tuition: Free for most programmes; some MSc ~€2,000–€3,000/semester for non-EU

finder.name: RWTH Aachen University
finder.cycle: Winter: by Jul 15 (international) · Summer: by Jan 15

finder.name: Karlsruhe Institute of Technology (KIT)
finder.cycle: Winter: by Jul 15 · Master dates vary

finder.name: Ludwig Maximilian University of Munich
finder.cycle: Winter: by Jul 15 · Summer: by Jan 15

routes.system: Provincial education, co-op and post-grad certificates
routes.intro: Education is run by the provinces, so rules differ in Ontario, BC, Quebec and elsewhere. Universities offer 4-year bachelor's degrees (3 in some provinces) and many offer co-op programmes with paid work terms. Colleges offer 1–3 year diplomas and post-graduate certificates; a Post-Graduation Work Permit (PGWP) depends on the programme and institution being eligible.

items.name: College diploma / advanced diploma
items.detail: 2–3 years, applied and job-oriented (e.g. Seneca, Humber, Conestoga). PGWP eligibility depends on the field of study; check the current IRCC list.

items.name: Bachelor's (BSc / BEng / BCom / BA)
items.detail: 4 years. Apply through provincial portals such as OUAC (Ontario) or directly to universities. Co-op streams add 12–20 months of paid experience.

items.name: Master's (MSc / MEng / MBA)
items.detail: 1–2 years. GRE/GMAT depending on programme; MEng is course-based and popular with Indian students.

items.name: Post-graduate certificate
items.detail: 8–16 months after a degree, mostly at colleges; short route into jobs.

items.name: PhD
items.detail: 4–5 years, usually funded.

careers.title: Canadian Engineering (BEng → Engineer-in-Training → P.Eng)
careers.regulator: Provincial regulators (PEO in Ontario, Engineers & Geoscientists BC, OIQ in Quebec) via Engineers Canada
careers.summary: Using the title 'Professional Engineer' (P.Eng) requires a licence from the provincial regulator. Graduating from a CEAB-accredited programme is the simplest route.

steps.detail: Choose a programme accredited by the Canadian Engineering Accreditation Board.
Work permit of up to 3 years if your programme is PGWP-eligible; gives time to gain experience.
Register with the provincial regulator while you accumulate experience.
Ethics, law and professional practice exam.

steps.stage: 5. 4 years of experience, including 1 year in Canada
steps.detail: Supervised by a P.Eng; then apply for the P.Eng licence.
Skilled work in Canada counts toward the CRS system; provincial nominee programmes also exist.

careers.title: Canadian Medicine & Nursing (MCCQE / NCLEX-RN)
careers.regulator: Medical Council of Canada (MCC) / provincial colleges / nursing regulators
careers.summary: Canadian MD schools heavily favour residents; international students are rarely admitted. Foreign-trained doctors apply for residency through CaRMS after the MCCQE and NAC OSCE; nurses write the NCLEX-RN after a NNAS assessment.

steps.detail: Doctors: verify with Physician Credentials Repository (PCRC); nurses: National Nursing Assessment Service (NNAS).
Required for IMGs to enter residency through CaRMS.
Residency match; IMG seats are limited and competitive.
Provincial College of Physicians and Surgeons grants the licence; nurses register with a provincial nursing college.

careers.title: Canadian Accounting (Degree → CPA Canada → PR)
careers.regulator: CPA Canada and provincial CPA bodies
careers.summary: CPA Canada is the single national designation. International students can study in Canada, complete the CPA prerequisites and professional programme, then work toward permanent residence.

steps.detail: Accounting and business courses; some universities offer accredited programmes.
Core and elective modules.
A 3-day capstone exam.
Practical experience at a firm or industry.

routes.intro: The Australian Qualifications Framework (AQF) sets ten levels, from certificates to doctorates. Universities offer 3-year bachelor's (4 for honours or engineering), and the Group of Eight (Go8) are the research leaders. Applications go to each university or through state centres such as UAC (NSW/ACT) and VTAC (Victoria). Intakes are February/March and July.

items.name: Foundation / Diploma
items.detail: 6–12 months, direct pathway into the second year of a bachelor's at partner universities.

items.name: Bachelor's (AQF 7)
items.detail: 3 years; 4 years for engineering and honours. Apply to the university or via UAC/VTAC.

items.name: Master's by coursework (AQF 9)
items.detail: 1.5–2 years; popular for IT, engineering, business.

items.name: Vocational (TAFE / VET)
items.detail: Certificate III/IV and diplomas, work-focused; may support skills occupation routes.

items.name: PhD
items.detail: 3–4 years; scholarships (RTP) often cover fees and stipend.

careers.title: Australian Engineering (Engineers Australia accreditation)
careers.summary: Choose a programme accredited under the Washington/Sydney Accords. Engineers Australia accreditation also supports skills assessment for migration.

steps.stage: 1. Accredited bachelor's (4 yrs) or master's (2 yrs)
steps.detail: Engineers Australia lists accredited programmes.
Post-study work rights; length depends on qualification and regional study. Verify current rules.
Engineers Australia assesses your qualification for migration visas.
Requires professional engagement and competencies.

careers.title: Australian Medicine, Nursing & Allied Health (AHPRA)
careers.regulator: AHPRA / Medical Board of Australia / AMC
careers.summary: International places in Australian medicine are limited and costly. Overseas-trained doctors pass AMC exams to register; nurses register with the Nursing and Midwifery Board.

steps.detail: Graduate-entry medicine uses GAMSAT; direct-entry uses UCAT ANZ.
Mix of university and hospital training.
Provisional registration with AHPRA.
AMC MCQ, AMC clinical exam, then a pathway through specialist colleges.

careers.title: Australian Accounting (CPA Australia / CA ANZ)
careers.summary: An accredited degree is followed by the professional programme; accounting is a common occupation for skilled migration, but the assessment rules change.

steps.detail: Bachelor's or master's.
CPA Program (strategic level) or CA Program.
Required for full CPA membership.

routes.system: National Framework of Qualifications (NFQ) and CAO
routes.intro: Irish degrees follow the NFQ: Level 7 ordinary degree (3 years), Level 8 honours degree (3–4 years) and Level 9 master's (1–2 years). Undergraduate entry for EU students is through the CAO points system; non-EU applicants usually apply directly to the university or through an agent-free international office. The country hosts European headquarters of Google, Meta and many pharma firms.

items.name: Foundation / pathway
items.detail: 1 year for Indian students who need extra preparation before direct entry.

items.name: Honours bachelor's (Level 8)
items.detail: 3–4 years; 4 years in engineering and many sciences.

items.name: Master's (Level 9)
items.detail: 1–2 years; taught or research.

items.name: Graduate-entry professional courses
items.detail: Medicine, nursing and dentistry have separate quotas and exams.

items.name: PhD (Level 10)
items.detail: 4 years, funded by research bodies.

careers.title: Irish Tech & Data (BSc/MSc → Graduate Stamp 1G → Critical Skills Permit)
careers.summary: Ireland's tech hub in Dublin recruits international graduates. After a bachelor's or master's you can apply for the Stamp 1G Graduate Programme, and then a Critical Skills Employment Permit for in-demand roles.

steps.detail: Choose courses recognised on the Irish Register of Qualifications.
Work up to 20 hours/week during term, full-time in holidays.
12 months after Level 8 or 24 months after Level 9 or higher.
For roles on the Critical Skills list; salary thresholds apply. Leads to Stamp 4 after 2 years.

careers.title: Irish Medicine & Nursing (HPAT history, Medical Council)
careers.summary: Irish medicine is offered to non-EU applicants at fee-paying seats (RCSI, UCD, TCD, UCC, UL, UCG). Entry tests and criteria have been changing, so check each school.

steps.detail: HPAT and similar tests have been revised or retired in recent years; check each university.
Pre-clinical and clinical training.
Required before full registration.
Medical Council of Ireland / NMBI for nurses and midwives.

careers.title: Irish Finance (ACCA / Chartered Accountants Ireland, IFSC Dublin)
careers.summary: Dublin's International Financial Services Centre hires graduates in funds, banking and audit.

steps.detail: Level 8 or 9.
Big 4 and funds firms; exam support.
Professional qualification.

routes.intro: Singapore's six autonomous universities (NUS, NTU, SMU, SUTD, SIT, SUSS) award globally recognised degrees. International students apply directly, and tuition grants (in return for a work bond) are available for some. Polytechnics offer 3-year diplomas, and top diploma graduates can join university in year 2.

items.name: Polytechnic diploma
items.detail: 3 years, applied; Singapore-Cambridge GCE or equivalent.

items.name: Bachelor's (4 years)
items.detail: Direct entry with Class 12 results plus SAT or subject tests at some universities; honours degree in 4 years.

items.name: Master's
items.detail: 1–2 years coursework; GRE/GMAT for some.

items.name: PhD
items.detail: 4 years; scholarships such as the NUS and NTU research scholarships.

careers.title: Singapore Finance & Fintech (Degree → MAS ecosystem → Employment Pass)
careers.regulator: Monetary Authority of Singapore (MAS) / Ministry of Manpower (MOM)
careers.summary: Singapore is Asia's wealth-management and fintech hub. Foreign graduates need an employer sponsor; the Employment Pass uses the COMPASS points framework.

steps.detail: NUS, NTU, SMU.
Most hiring starts from internships.
CFA, CAIA and MAS representative exams; ISCA qualification for accountants.
Employer-sponsored; salary thresholds and COMPASS apply.

careers.title: Singapore Engineering (Degree → PEB → Professional Engineer)
careers.summary: Engineers register with PEB after an accredited degree and practical experience; Singapore needs engineers in semiconductors, aerospace, and built environment.

steps.detail: NUS, NTU, SUTD.
Entry-level exam.
Usually 4 years.
Then PE registration.

careers.title: Singapore Medicine (NUS / NTU LKCMedicine → SMC)
careers.summary: Two local medical schools and Duke-NUS for graduates; international seats are few. Registration with SMC follows the housemanship.

steps.detail: Interviews (MMI) and aptitude tests; check requirements.
At NUS Yong Loo Lin or NTU LKCMedicine.
1 year and SMC registration.

finder.name: National University of Singapore (NUS)
finder.cycle: UG: Oct–Mar (varies by qualification) · PG: Nov–Jan

finder.name: Singapore University of Technology and Design (SUTD)
